{{Quote|Are you certain that Baroness Omnino wasn't followed from the Vena system?''"<br />"''Yes, Chancellor. Every precaution was taken. But since the Baroness has been marked by assassination by the Vena Isolationists, it is regrettable that she rejected a Jedi escort.|Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum and Staff Aide Sei Taria|<ref name="Last1" />}}
A [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] '''civil war''' was fought in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Vena system/Legends|Vena system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. With [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Kindoro]]'s ascension to the [[Venan royal family|throne]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vena]] sometime after [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], the Vena [[Star system/Legends|system]] was opened to [[Free-trader|free trade]], marking an abrupt change from the customary policies constituted throughout its history. Built on the traditions of independence and isolationism, Venan society strongly opposed that measure, and [[Vena Isolationists|reactionary groups]] took up arms against the Venan royal family. Following Kindoro's natural [[Death/Legends|death]], [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], the [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]], rose to power, which considerably deteriorated the state of affairs.

Omnino proved to be an even more intolerant and ruthless ruler than her late husband, and adamantly led the efforts to crush the insurgency until her death in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]] at the hands of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Jinn, along with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], had unraveled a large, illegal scheme to have Vena admitted as a Republic world and gain support from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] against the Isolationists. When confronted with the truth, the Baroness threatened to kill [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], to which Jinn responded by swiftly [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] Omnino. Up until her death, the initial crisis and subsequent civil war had raged for at least twenty years.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I suspect they want to open a trade route to Vena. But if that is the Baroness' goal, she will first need our help to bring unity to her own troubled star system.|Staff Aide Sei Taria, to Chancellor Finis Valorum|<ref name="Last1" />}}
[[File:Hapes_and_Vena.png|thumb|right|250px|The Vena system and its vicinities, including the Hapes Cluster]]
Descended from early [[Hapan]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]],<ref name="btr" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|411|Omnino, Baroness}}</ref> [[Venan|inhabitants]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vena]],<ref name="btr" /> located in the [[Vena system/Legends|system of the same name]] in the [[Nojic sector/Legends|Nojic sector]] within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="TEA" /> had a historical tradition of maintaining an independent and isolationist stance in their [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. They remained unaffiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], even though Vena and the Republic shared a good relationship, and the Venans would occasionally [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] with the nearby [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] for items they could not produce themselves. Other than that, Venans preferred to be left on their own.<ref name="btr" />

After [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the rise of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Kindoro]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], Baroness [[Omnino]], to power on Vena changed that historic position. Because Kindoro and Omnino had previously both served as [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]]<ref name="btr" /> to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] planets<ref name="TEA" /> of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], respectively, their contact with foreign cultures and goods exposed the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] to certain amenities that were inaccessible from their home system. For that reason, Kindoro implemented [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|economic]] deregulation and pursued ratification of [[Free-trader|trade]] agreements with other worlds in order to make commodities available exclusively to the [[Venan royal family]]. Since the Baron and his family controlled shipping, that course of action initially did not find resistance.<ref name="btr" />

==The civil war==
===Armed conflict===
{{Quote|Death to the Baroness!|A mind-controlled Senate Guard shortly before attempting to kill Omnino on Coruscant|<ref name="Last1" />}}
The radical shift toward economic and cultural openness eventually evoked a commotion among many Venans, who resented not just the fact that only the royal family was benefiting from the new influx of foreign products, but also that their newly imported extravagant lifestyles were dissonant from traditional Venan conduct. The commoners, who rallied together as the [[Vena Isolationists]], called for a return to their closed borders and old-fashioned values, in opposition to the flamboyant way of life that their rulers were adopting. The regents, unwilling to give in to the demands of the protesters, imprisoned the movement leaders and sent them to [[Prison/Legends|labor camps]]. That move aggravated tensions and motivated the remaining members to manufacture [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], stage [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] strikes against Venan nobility, and to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] [[Freighter/Legends|cargo ships]].<ref name="btr" />

The terrorist attacks, however, only worsened the situation. The royal family deplored the commoners' intrusion into their affairs, while the populace refused to back down. The conflict further deteriorated after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Baron Kindoro by [[Heart/Legends|heart]] failure while traveling in Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Baroness Omnino, next in line to power, ascended to the throne and proved herself even more merciless than her husband, as she set as her top priority the quelling of the insurrection, even if it meant neglecting raising her son, Baron [[Sando (Baron)|Sando]]. She waged [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] war for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] against her subjects, who, although facing the Venan government, still wielded a good deal of [[Politics/Legends|political]] power.<ref name="btr" /> The Isolationists marked Omnino for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], forcing her to take extensive precautions when traveling from the Vena system to avoid pursuit and possible attacks.<ref name="Last1">[[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 1|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'' 1]]</ref> Throughout the war, the Baronness heavily invested in illegal [[brain-wave projection]] technology&mdash;[[mind control device]]s&mdash;in order to influence events outside of her system in her favor, since the devices were unable to effectively manipulate the movement leaders into turning themselves in.<ref name="btr" />

===Baroness Omnino's Republic campaign===
{{Quote|You fabricated an assassination attempt&hellip; killing a Senate Guard and your own guardian&hellip; to gain sympathy from the Galactic Senate?''"<br />"''And have my way with them. Now, Vena is a member of the Republic, and I have unlimited access to Ord Mantell.|Qui-Gon Jinn and Omnino|<ref name="Last3" />}}
[[File:Assassination_attempt_on_Baroness_Omnino.png|thumb|left|320px|The false flag assassination attempt on Baroness Omnino on Coruscant in 37 BBY used the Venan civil war as a pretext.]]
The war, however, did not halt Omnino's ambitious side plans. In [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]], she orchestrated a false flag [[Assassination attempt on Baroness Omnino|assassination attempt]] by using the mind control device against [[Unidentified Senate Guard (mind control)|one]] of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] protecting her, so that he would try to murder her upon her arrival on Coruscant for a meeting with Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. In manipulating him so, Omnino hoped to gain sympathy and support from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] against the Isolationists, as well as commence membership negotiations for Vena into the Republic. Individuals close to Chancellor Valorum, such as [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]], believed the visit was part of a strategy to help the Baroness further open her system by having a new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] established between Vena and the Republic, although even the Chancellor himself conceded that, if true, it would be a lucrative deal for the Republic for many generations to come.<ref name="Last1" />

The attack, which took the lives of the aforementioned Senate Guard and [[Omnino's bodyguard|another bodyguard]] who tried to protect the Baroness, successfully garnered commiseration from the Galactic Senate. Omnino, all the while secretly threatening the Chancellor's life, made Valorum efficaciously lobby for the admission of the Nojic [[Sector/Legends|sector]] planet into the Republic. Her off-world plot to have Vena admitted as a Republic world and gain the upper hand against the Isolationists was ultimately thwarted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who [[Mission to the Bright Jewel Cluster|investigated]] from the beginning and unraveled her elaborate scheme.<ref name="Last3">[[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 3|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'' 3]]</ref>

Omnino had made use of her investment in brain-wave projection technology when she gave a mind control device to [[land baron]] [[Taxer Sundown]], so he could provide supplies of [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]] meat<ref name="Last3" />&mdash;considered a delicacy by the Venan royal family<ref name="FF131">{{FactFile|131|ORD 1-2|Last Stand on Ord Mantell}}</ref>&mdash;from the<ref name="Last3" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to Vena, after her plan to [[Reproduction/Legends|breed]] Savrips on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] failed. The Baroness meant for Sundown to do so by killing the existing land barons, usurping their operations and seizing power on Ord Mantell for Omnino, goals that he successfully accomplished.<ref name="Last3" />

Jinn and Kenobi were at the shipment loading rendezvous point just as the Baroness arrived at the Ordnance/Regional Depot on her personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Benevolent III]]'', to transport the next batch of Savrip meat. Omnino brought the Chancellor, who was under the effects of the mind control device, on board her [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to Ord Mantell. After Jinn confronted Omnino with the truth, she threatened to kill the entranced Chancellor. In a quick succession of events, Jinn distracted her and swiftly beheaded her using the ''[[Sai cha/Legends|sai cha]]'' technique of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].<ref name="Last3" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You do realize the senators will insist on an investigation?''"<br />"''Of course, Chancellor. Meetings will be held, delegations will be sent to Vena and Ord Mantell.|An exchange between Finis Valorum and Qui-Gon Jinn, after the incident on Ord Mantell|<ref name="Last3" />}}
[[File:Vena_system.png|thumb|right|200px|The Vena system, crossed by the Lesser Lantillian Route]]
Up until Baroness Omnino's passing,<ref name="btr" /> the crisis and subsequent civil war on Vena had dragged on for around twenty years.<ref name="nb1">The web article [[Before the Rise]] states that the crisis that would turn into the civil war started approximately [[57 BBY/Legends|twenty five years]] before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], which according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' took place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Given that the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series [[Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'']] places itself roughly [[37 BBY/Legends|five years]] before the events on [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], it can be deducted that the civil war lasted for at around twenty years.</ref> Jinn and Chancellor Valorum predicted that her death would resonate with the Republic, generating meetings and delegations to Vena and Ord Mantell to investigate the incidents that led to her beheading.<ref name="Last3" />

During that period,<ref name="noteAtlas">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] in the region known as "[[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]]," a region which included the [[Vena system/Legends|Vena system]], existed during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The article [[Before the Rise]] states that Vena only opened up after [[Kindoro]] and [[Omnino]]'s rise to power, which means that the Lesser Lantillian Route could only have been established around this [[Time/Legends|time]] period.</ref> the Venan rulers, despite popular outcry, successfully connected the Vena system to a major hyperlane known as the [[Lesser Lantillian Route/Legends|Lesser Lantillian Route]], which spanned four [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions: the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], the Expansion Region, the Mid Rim, and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Although Omnino was killed thirty-seven years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Venan monarchy itself was not overthrown altogether after her passing, still existing around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], as evidenced by the use of the nobility title of [[Margravine|Royal Margravine]] by the Venan [[Abominelle]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FRR">''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Fire Ring Race]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Venan civil war was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell|first issue]] of [[Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'']],<ref name="Last1" /> a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series written by [[Ryder Windham]] and released in [[December 20]], [[2000]].<ref name="DH1">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-276/Star-Wars-Qui-Gon-and-Obi-Wan---Last-Stand-on-Ord-Mantell-1-of-3|text=Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan - Last Stand on Ord Mantell #1 (of 3)}}</ref> The comic featured a conversation between Staff Aide Sei Taria and Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum in which Taria fleetingly states that Baroness Omnino is marked for assassination by the Vena Isolationists.<ref name="Last1" />

The web-exclusive article [[Before the Rise]], published on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website on [[April 16]], [[2002]]<ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=http://theforce.net/rpg/story/Updates_at_Wizards_of_the_Coast_67719.asp|text=Updates at Wizards of the Coast|author=JF|date=2002-04-16|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20200930074612}}</ref> and written by [[J.D. Wiker]] as a scenario supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', later expanded the back-story of the conflict. It explained the reason why Omnino was wanted dead by the Isolationists, serving as a tie-in prequel to the comic series, albeit without indicating the outcome of the conflict.<ref name="btr" />
